assumptions.data: Synthetic scripted orders and iid random limit orders; no market data
assumptions.price_unit: integer ticks with unit tick value
assumptions.random_order_distribution: buy/sell equiprobable; prices 95..105, sizes 1..9, owners 0..7 uniform

assumptions.data: Synthetic; independent pre-generated external paths shared by policies
assumptions.arrival: Reference midpoint before first external event
assumptions.liquidity: Five levels per side, 10 units each, mid +/-3..7; fully refreshed every batch
assumptions.event_order: Refresh background, external IOC, parent IOC; no resting parent remainder
assumptions.shortfall: s*(notional-filled*arrival) + fees + s*residual*(terminal_mid-arrival); s=+1 buy, -1 sell
assumptions.residual: Unexecuted positive parent units; marked at terminal reference, not liquidated
assumptions.baseline: Release entire parent at batch zero and retry residual every batch
assumptions.twap: Cumulative floor(Q*(t+1)/T) target each batch; carry deficits, no forced terminal fill
assumptions.uncertainty: 16 independent paired seeds 200..215; Student t(15) 95% CI for TWAP minus baseline; negative favors TWAP
assumptions.boundaries: No calibrated flow, permanent impact, latency, funding, borrow cost, hidden depth, or fee tiers

assumptions.data: Synthetic; matched exogenous paths, no historical data
assumptions.timestamp_unit: abstract units; ten units per batch
assumptions.message_order: arrival timestamp then enqueue sequence, including ties
assumptions.stale_definition: Fill at/after cancel request, before successful cancellation
assumptions.liquidation: Five refreshed levels, ten units each, mid +/- 3..7; fees included
assumptions.other_costs: No funding, borrow or calibrated market impact

plan.question: Does the previously observed net-versus-inventory tradeoff persist on new paired synthetic paths?
plan.freeze_scope: Existing policies and simulator fixed before evaluating the listed confirmation seeds; no external preregistration or timestamp authority is claimed.
plan.exposure_definition: Arithmetic mean of absolute end-of-batch inventory across all 240 batches before liquidation, including zero inventory.
plan.contrasts: Inventory skew minus symmetric and delayed refresh minus symmetric, separately in each regime.
plan.interval: Pointwise two-sided 95% Student t, sample sd with ddof=1, df=31; pair before estimating uncertainty; no multiplicity adjustment.
plan.interpretation_rule: For each contrast and regime, upper net interval below zero and upper exposure interval below zero confirms lower net with lower exposure. Otherwise retain the unresolved or opposite finding. No aggregate winner or policy retuning.
plan.sample_rule: Exactly 32 seeds per regime; no optional stopping or dropping seeds.

costs.liquidation: Five refreshed finite levels per side at terminal mid +/-3..7, ten units each; liquidation fees included in net.

plan.data: Synthetic pre-generated draws shared by policies within seed and regime; regimes reuse seeds and are not independent replicates.

event_log.assumptions: Synthetic finite-depth execution; direct in-memory baseline, same accepted commands; 0.05 tick per parent executed unit; zero funding/borrow costs. Replay requires no random seed. Fee sink is external.

provenance.data: Synthetic Gaussian midprice moves and distance-dependent arrivals; separate synthetic order-book scenarios

limitations: Legacy policy metrics still use the quote-arrival model, independently of the new order book.
Order book is a single-instrument limit-order model; the latency study adds a deterministic message queue, without amendments, auctions, hidden liquidity or self-trade prevention.
No calibrated adverse-selection, market-impact, or endogenous order-flow model.
Order-book accounting assumes zero fees/costs and unlimited credit/shorting; legacy simulator charges 0.001 per filled unit.
Legacy terminal inventory is marked at mid without liquidation costs; applied quoting and latency cases liquidate through finite depth. Simulated PnL is not evidence of tradability.
